name: glasscn-ui
summary: shadcn/ui component library with glassmorphism variants, extra components and Tailwind theming, published on npm.
description: A themable shadcn/ui component library published on npm as glasscn-ui. Components with solid surfaces gain opt-in glassmorphic variants (a glass variant plus customizable blur), alongside new pieces such as CircularProgress, ComboBox, DotIndicator and a gradient HeadingTitle. Theming goes through createTailwindPreset() with color aliases for primary, secondary, gray, danger and warning. Calendar, Carousel, Chart, Form and Sonner are intentionally excluded; the GitHub repo was archived in September 2026.
contains: shadcn/ui components with opt-in glassmorphic variants (variant, blur props)
new components: ComboBox, DotIndicator, HeadingTitle, CircularProgress
excludes Calendar, Carousel, Chart, Form, Sonner
